newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch free Hague petrol bomb attack suspects.
newsitem.headline: Dutch free Hague petrol bomb attack suspects.

text.p: Five men arrested over two petrol bomb attacks in a Hague suburb have been released and are not suspects in another fire that same night which killed six, the Hague public prosecutor said on Friday.
A Turkish woman and five of her children died at their home in the same area of the capital on Tuesday night in what Dutch media have reported may have been a racist arson attack.
"These persons are not suspected of arson in the house," the prosecutor's office said in a statement.

"(They)...were held on suspicion of throwing molotov cocktails at two cultural centres/coffeehouses in the area," it said. "The prosecutor has decided to let (them) go, because they all have a firm alibi and could not have been involved."
The buildings attacked housed an Azerbaijani-Turkish centre and a Turkish islamic association, but police have refused to comment on any possible link between the incidents.
